eval_instructions: Each case is one user prompt sent to a headless agent with only the model-apps plugin loaded. `expect` is the model-apps skill the agent must invoke in its FIRST TURN (genpage | app-builder | report-issue | telemetry), or null when it must invoke none of them in that turn; a skill asked for only after a first turn that chose none is reported as a later fallback and is not graded (--grade eventual counts it). `accept` lists other outcomes that are also correct for a genuinely ambiguous prompt. `trap` names the mis-route the case exists to catch. Graded by run-routing.js over N trials against a pass-rate threshold.

evals.prompt: Add a generative page to my existing Sales Hub model-driven app that shows accounts as a gallery of cards.
Build me a model-driven app to manage equipment rentals: customers, rentals, and returns.
Build a Power Pages site where customers can submit warranty claims.
evals.trap: "build a site/page" wording bleeding into /genpage; Power Pages is a different product
